in_marathi.name: Sanchita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Accomplished, complete, perfect
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanchita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanchita refers to that which is complete and perfect. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'samsara-chita', which means 'memory of all past lives'. In Hinduism, Sanchita represents the sum total of a person's karmas or actions, which determines their future birth and destiny.
